title: Unverified: Satellite images reportedly show sunken Russian warship off Libya after suspected Ukrainian strike
detail: A news aggregator headline dated Nov 23, 2026 reports that satellite images show a sunken Russian warship following a suspected Ukrainian strike off Libya. Only the headline was available: the original outlet, vessel identity, location, date of the strike and the attacker are all unconfirmed. Treat as unverified until corroborated by a primary or major-outlet source.
confidenceReason: Single aggregated headline; originating outlet and details not verified.
